description: Estimates round-trip flights and lodging in USD for guest groups departing from supported US metros. Stay length and guests per room can be set, and default to the destination’s typical stay in a private room per guest. Each priced group gives a typical figure and a low-to-high range. Partial totals include only priced groups; unpriced guests and unsupported origins are reported separately. The urlRestoresEstimate field states whether the returned web link restores the supplied groups. Estimates are not live fares or bookings.

destination.description: Destination slug. Supported: algarve, amalfi-coast, argentina, aruba, aspen, bahamas, bali, barbados, barcelona, bermuda, cabo, cancun, cape-town, capri, charleston, cinque-terre, colombia, costa-rica, cotswolds, dominican-republic, dubrovnik, fiji, hawaii, iceland, ireland, jamaica, japan, kenya, lake-como, maldives, mallorca, maui, montenegro, morocco, mykonos, napa-valley, new-zealand, paris, peru, provence, puerto-rico, punta-cana, ravello, santorini, savannah, scottish-highlands, sorrento, sri-lanka, st-lucia, swiss-alps, thailand, dolomites, tulum, turks-and-caicos, tuscany, us-virgin-islands, vietnam.

count.description: Number of guests from this city (default 1)

guests_per_room.description: Guests sharing each room, 1 to 4. Defaults to 1, a private room per guest; 2 prices couples sharing.

nights.description: Nights in the room, 1 to 30. Defaults to the destination's typical stay, shown as typicalStayNights on each group.

name: get_guest_travel_estimate
